title: Data layer
description: Connection pooling and caching for the selected environment: PgBouncer pools, Redis memory, clients and Pub/Sub, and the backend's SQLAlchemy pools.

list.name: Deployment rollouts
list.expr: max by (namespace, deployment, replicaset) (max by (namespace, replicaset) (kube_replicaset_created{namespace=~"${env}-ns|keycloak-ns"}) * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (deployment) max by (namespace, replicaset, deployment) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace=~"${env}-ns|keycloak-ns", owner_kind="Deployment"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"))) * 1000

list.name: env
list.label: Environment
list.description: Deployment environment. Workload selectors are built from it as <env>-ns, <env>-api and so on, matching baseConfig.environment in only-chance-devops. Add prod here when it exists.

panels.title: PgBouncer down
panels.description: PgBouncer instances (the environment's HA pods and Keycloak's) that report down, or whose exporter cannot be scraped.

panels.title: PgBouncer pool usage (max)
panels.description: Highest server pool usage across PgBouncer instances and databases: active server connections / pool_size. Same formula as the pgbouncer-pool-exhausted alert.

targets.expr: max((sum by (pgbouncer_instance, database) (pgbouncer_pools_server_active_connections{database!="pgbouncer"}) / sum by (pgbouncer_instance, database) (pgbouncer_databases_pool_size{database!="pgbouncer"} > 0)) * 100)

panels.title: Clients waiting
panels.description: Clients queued for a server connection right now, across all PgBouncer pools.

panels.title: Redis memory (max)
panels.description: Highest used / maxmemory across Redis pods. The policy is noeviction, so at 100% Redis rejects writes.

panels.title: Redis masters
panels.description: Pods reporting the master role. Anything other than exactly 1 means Sentinel failover is broken or in progress.

panels.title: Redis rejected conns
panels.description: Connections Redis refused (maxclients reached) in the selected range.

panels.title: App pool usage (max)
panels.description: Highest SQLAlchemy pool usage of any backend pod or job: checked-out / capacity.

targets.expr: max((sum by (instance, application_name) (only_chance_database_pool_checked_out) / sum by (instance, application_name) (only_chance_database_pool_capacity > 0)) * 100)

panels.title: Pool checkout timeouts
panels.description: Times a backend request gave up waiting for a database connection in the selected range. The series only exists after the first timeout, so 0 here usually means none ever happened.

panels.title: Server pool usage
panels.description: Active server connections / pool_size per PgBouncer instance and database.

targets.expr: label_replace((sum by (pgbouncer_instance, database) (pgbouncer_pools_server_active_connections{database!="pgbouncer"}) / sum by (pgbouncer_instance, database) (pgbouncer_databases_pool_size{database!="pgbouncer"} > 0)) * 100, "pod", "$1", "pgbouncer_instance", "([^.:]+).*")

panels.title: Client connections
panels.description: Client connections paired with a server connection (active) and queued for one (waiting).

panels.title: Longest client wait
panels.description: Age of the oldest queued client. Above zero means requests are waiting on the pool.

panels.title: Queries per second
panels.description: Queries routed through PgBouncer.

panels.title: Average query time
panels.description: Mean time a query held a server connection.

panels.title: Server connections by state
panels.description: Connections from PgBouncer to PostgreSQL: active (serving a client), idle (ready) and used (awaiting reset).

panels.title: Client wait time
panels.description: Seconds clients spent waiting for a server connection, per second: roughly the average number of clients waiting.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Used memory per Redis pod against maxmemory (noeviction: writes fail when full).

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (instance, role) (redis_memory_used_bytes * on (instance) group_left (role) redis_instance_info), "pod", "$1", "instance", "([^.:]+).*")

panels.title: Commands per second
panels.description: Commands processed per pod.

panels.title: Clients
panels.description: Connected clients and clients blocked on BLPOP-style commands.

panels.title: Keyspace hit ratio
panels.description: Share of key lookups that found the key.

panels.title: Evictions, expirations and rejections
panels.description: Expirations are normal TTL cleanup. Evictions should stay at zero with noeviction; rejections mean maxclients was hit.

panels.title: Top commands
panels.description: The ten most frequent commands across all pods.

panels.title: Pub/Sub
panels.description: Active Pub/Sub channels and pattern subscriptions on the master (Socket.IO and backend listeners use these). A drop to zero means subscribers disconnected.

panels.title: Keys on master
panels.description: Keys per logical database on the master.

panels.title: Replica link
panels.description: 1 when a replica is connected to its master. Masters do not report this series.

panels.title: Pool usage by application
panels.description: Checked-out / capacity of the SQLAlchemy pools, summed across each application's pods.

panels.title: Checked-out connections
panels.description: Database connections held by each application right now.

panels.title: Checkout timeouts
panels.description: Requests that gave up waiting for a pooled connection.

panels.title: Pools by pod
panels.description: Current pool state per backend pod or job run.
